### Phase 1: output-preserving encode speed fixes

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase1-output-preserving/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Output-preserving corrections from sources/outside-advice.md Phase 1:
exact zero return and precomputed steps in HfQuantizer::choose; bounded
block_cost and CfL residual cost; precomputed LF X/B factor costs;
shared modular plane storage (no per-trial deep clone); specialized
single-leaf residual paths for Gradient/Zero/West. Codestreams must
stay byte-identical to the pre-Phase-1 encoder for the same requests.
